description.value: Zeeka Company is a Vancouver-area artisan bakery and professional culinary school founded 16 years ago by chef Zahra Khodadadi, specializing in handcrafted wedding cakes, French and Iranian pastries, macarons, and danishes. Everything is made from scratch using natural ingredients by chefs trained in France and Iran. The Zeeka Academy arm also offers professional pastry and cake-decorating courses.
